label: XGS-PON OLT class N2, 8 ports
notes: ITU-T G.9807.1 Table B.9.3 (9.95328 Gbit/s downstream): OLT mean launched power +4.0..+7.0 dBm for class N2, ONU sensitivity -28.0 dBm. Upstream OLT receiver per Table B.9.4: -28.0 dBm sensitivity, -7.0 dBm overload. Table B.9.3 prints one N2 column. The +4..+8 dBm and +10.5..+12.5 dBm pair belongs to XG-PON's N2a/N2b columns (G.987.2 Amd. 1, Table 9-3), where the boosted column is what an OLT pays for a -21.5 dBm ONU; G.9807.1 has no such split and its ONU receiver is -28.0 dBm for every class, so this row is the whole of XGS-PON class N2, not its low-power half. Corrected 2026-11-27: the note used to quote G.987.2's N2a/N2b pair and call this row the N2a variant. Class N2 assumes 16-31 dB of ODN loss (Table B.9.2): a shorter span can overload the ONT, so budget an attenuator rather than extra reach. Replace with the OLT's own datasheet for the line card actually purchased before construction.
